constraints_found.constraint: Peanut allergy at the table: no peanut in any form (deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: cyrus, you're off duty tonight. i'm the one keeping anything peanut, in any form, off our table. one satay incident per friendship is plenty

constraints_found.constraint: Budget: $$ (nice, not fancy); $$$ is one tier over
constraints_found.source_line: the trip's paid for, so tonight runs on the fun budget. the fun budget does nice. it does not do fancy. somewhere fancy and i'll spend my own send-off doing sums on a napkin

constraints_found.constraint: Craving: Italian / pasta (not the Greek place)
constraints_found.source_line: it was. but maya's about to live on fried fish off a pier for the whole trip. so tonight we send her off twirling pasta

constraints_found.constraint: Several meat- and fish-free mains to choose from
constraints_found.source_line: can i ask for something again? somewhere with a few dishes to choose from that have no meat or fish in them :)

constraints_found.constraint: Dairy intolerance (cheese/cream makes her ill; costs a star, not a deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: Mostly off duty. Roxy, I've watched you order. You'll point straight at whatever comes buried in cheese or swimming in cream, and spend dessert doubled over.

constraints_found.constraint: Fresh, light food, nothing heavy (rules out fried)
constraints_found.source_line: confession: i planned this whole night eating crackers over my laptop. tonight i want a plate that's fresh and bright, not one more heavy thing

venue_assessment.waterfront_breakwater: Italian $$, four meat/fish-free mains, no fryer, no dairy at all, never any peanuts. Meets everything: 3 stars.
venue_assessment.waterfront_tidewater: Greek, so misses the pasta craving; otherwise safe, light, dairy-free, vegetarian options: 2 stars.
venue_assessment.waterfront_keel_street: Roasted peanuts in the busiate, caponata and salad, bowl on the pass: deal-breaker, 0 stars.
venue_assessment.waterfront_marina_arch: No meat/fish-free main anywhere (vegetable dishes hide anchovy, pancetta, ham, tuna): misses Mina, 2 stars at best.
venue_assessment.waterfront_pier_nine: Dairy in every pasta, butter on greens, cream and mozzarella: costs a star for Roxy, 2 stars.
venue_assessment.waterfront_quayside: $$$, one tier over the 'nice not fancy' budget: 2 stars.
venue_assessment.waterfront_bluewater: Everything fried, heavy (reviewer slept through alarm): misses Brooke's light request, 2 stars.

notes: Every decoy fails exactly one constraint, which makes it a clean elimination puzzle with a single 3-star answer. Fair.

The peanut clue is sharp: Keel Street's first review looks perfect (dairy-free, vegetarian column, light) and the peanuts only show up in the second review. Good trap that rewards reading every review.
Marina Arch is a nice trap too: the menu names the same dishes as Breakwater (orecchiette, ciambotta, caponata) but each hides meat or fish. Readers who skim dish names could pick it.
Roxy's dairy intolerance is only stated indirectly through Cyrus ('buried in cheese or swimming in cream... doubled over'). It is inferable but a little oblique; acceptable for a late level.

Liam's Italian craving is framed as 'twirling pasta' against Roxy's Greek suggestion. Tidewater is Greek and still serves no pasta on the card, so the craving miss is clear. Minor ambiguity: Mina's request could be read as a strict diet rather than a preference; it doesn't change the pick.
Brooke's 'fresh and bright, not heavy' maps to Bluewater's all-fried menu clearly.
